messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.
- [constraint] Per policy, every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. (since 2025-07-29; source standup/ember/2025-07-29)
- [constraint] Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. (since 2025-02-18; source standup/ember/2025-02-18)
- The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. (since 2025-03-04; source standup/atlas/2025-03-04)
- Team Dune noticed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the auth gateway's owners. (since 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-05-22-2)
- The authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. (since 2025-05-07; source standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2)
- On 2025-09-16, Oskar wrote the authentication gateway handover document for Diego. (since 2025-09-16; source handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway)
- The Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate rise and pinged the authentication gateway's owners. (since 2025-05-07; source standup/boreal/2025-05-07-2)
- The authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team. (since 2025-01-20; source standup/ember/2025-01-20)
- On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway over to the Cinder team. (since 2025-09-16; source handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway)
- The Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. (since 2025-09-03; source standup/cinder/2025-09-03-2)
- INC-2025-017 was an incident where the auth gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02. (since 2025-08-07; source incident-review/INC-2025-017)
- [constraint] Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request. (since 2025-04-02; source standup/ember/2025-04-02)
- [decision] As of 2026-01-30, the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. (since 2026-01-30; source standup/cinder/2026-01-30)
- [decision] The billing API gates the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. (since 2025-09-30; source standup/atlas/2025-09-30)
- The root cause of INC-2026-009 was two leaders elected during a network partition. (since 2026-05-19; source incident-review/INC-2026-009)
- [decision] Webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys, since a partner asked for key rotation in their security review. (since 2025-11-03; source standup/boreal/2025-11-03)
- Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners. (since 2025-02-21; source standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2)
- The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. (since 2025-02-21; source standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2)
- [decision] The Ember team does pairing on every production change. (since 2025-02-06; source standup/ember/2025-02-06-2)
- The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate. (since 2025-08-07; source incident-review/INC-2025-017)

Question: What does a change to auth-gateway need before it can merge?

message.content: Two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off
